notes: acme-template 2.0.0 (vendored, with a CHANGELOG) replaced the default export render(tpl, data) with compile(tpl, { strict })(data), changed {name} placeholders to {{name}}, and throws on missing values unless strict is false. The README keeps optional fields empty when missing, as 1.x did. Only 2.0.0 is available.
